name: Example: Tasmania & the Alps
author: Golf Tycoon examples
description: A world mod: two new course locations on the globe - a windswept Tasmanian links stocked with its own visiting golfers, and a big Alpine mountain site - buyable by any company launched while the mod is on. Shows how locations (and the golfers who visit them) are pure data: theme and size by name, a pin by latitude and longitude.
